title: Nomograms.jl
text: A nomogram is an analog computer printed on paper. Lay a straightedge through the values you know, and it crosses the remaining scale at the answer — no power, no keystrokes, just geometry. Nomograms.jl builds them from the formulas you already use, solves them numerically, and draws them as SVG …

text: A pivot works only when the first two variables collapse into a single intermediate. When they do not, one of the three points an alignment line crosses must carry two variables at once. That is a Net: a two-parameter surface (u, v) -> (x, y), drawn as a mesh. Deriving one follows the same pattern …
